paragraphs: He lived in the time of Shmuel’s father. Mentioned in [Yevamot 115b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.115b.9); he was not a Torah scholar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman explicitly says that he was not a Torah scholar.
The linked Yevamot has Androlinai’s name in a divorce document. Shmuel’s father forwards the case to Rabbi Yehudah Nesia, who calls for a search for another man of the same name.
